adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the event is built with `destinationCalendar: ... : null` (when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists). Later, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional chaining makes the push a no-op, so `teamDestinationCalendars` are never added. This matches the finding: collective hosts' destination calendars are silently dropped specifically in the fallback path where organizer/eventType have no destinationCalendar.
